data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: A fixture exists at EXACTLY plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep/ with a synthetic codebase containing at least 5 call sites of a target signature, one intentionally omitted from the sweep.
- dd-6: The fixture is stack-generic — the target signature is covered for the repo's primary stack (Python). dd-6's chosen OR-branch is "covered for the repo's primary stack"; a non-Python fixture is OUT OF SCOPE.

## Implementation
Create a synthetic Python fixture under plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep/app/ : __init__.py, users.py, orders.py, reports.py, legacy_helpers.py. Across these modules place at least FIVE NON-test, NON-import call sites of `legacy_call` (real call expressions, not import/from-import lines, not under any test path), plus EXACTLY ONE call site annotated with a `# OMITTED-SITE` marker comment (the site task-2's completeness re-query must catch). Add fixture-config.conf pinning migration.call_site_threshold low enough that the fixture's call-site count is deterministically over threshold, so migration-class-detect.sh (LANG default python) classifies the target as migration-class:sweep.

dd-6 scope note: the satisfied branch is the OR-branch "covered for the repo's primary stack" (Python = repo primary stack + migration-class-detect.sh LANG default). A non-Python fixture is explicitly out of scope.

## TDD Test Spec
Given the synthetic Python fixture with ≥5 non-test non-import legacy_call sites, one '# OMITTED-SITE' site, and fixture-config.conf pinning the threshold; When migration-class-detect.sh legacy_call python <fixture> runs with WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE→fixture-config.conf; Then the emitted marker JSON has "migration-class":"sweep", proving the Python primary-stack target is detected over threshold.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Fixture package exists at the EXACT path with all 5 modules
  Verify: for f in __init__ users orders reports legacy_helpers; do test -f plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep/app/$f.py || exit 1; done
- [ ] dd-1: ≥5 non-test, non-import legacy_call call sites
  Verify: [ $(grep -rhnE 'legacy_call\s*\(' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep/app/ | grep -vE '^[^:]*:[0-9]+:\s*(import |from .* import)' | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -ge 5 ]
- [ ] dd-1: exactly one '# OMITTED-SITE'-marked call site
  Verify: [ $(grep -rh '# OMITTED-SITE' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep/app/ | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -eq 1 ]
- [ ] fixture-config.conf pins migration.call_site_threshold
  Verify: grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*migration\.call_site_threshold[[:space:]]*=' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep/fixture-config.conf
- [ ] dd-6 (primary-stack coverage): the Python fixture target is detected as a sweep via migration-class-detect.sh python LANG default (a non-Python fixture is out of scope; this run evidences stack coverage)
  Verify: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep/fixture-config.conf bash plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh legacy_call python plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/tests/fixtures/migration-sweep | grep -q '"migration-class":"sweep"'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Create synthetic Python migration-sweep fixture (>=5 legacy_call sites + one OMITTED-SITE) with pinned threshold config
